reason: Verify no regression in Web cookie/CSRF behavior, safe DTOs, or credential isolation.
Verify one Alembic head, migration/model parity, isolated migration admission, and safe rollback.
Verify tenant predicates, dedup/restore/retry behavior, deletion races, and object cleanup.
Verify captured ready/needs_asr outcomes and completion events remain durable, atomic, and privacy-safe.
Verify server-side YouTube remains compatible and browser capture does not weaken existing content/failure guards.
Verify production OpenAPI composition and generated TypeScript remain canonical and current.
Run required Web gates and inspect privacy, async-state, mobile, and accessibility behavior.
Audit every extension/API/service/storage/worker/retrieval/UI boundary and round-trip format.
Check that platform and capture contracts have single owners rather than scattered parsing/conditionals.
Check implementation against discovered auth, quota, ingestion, build, and test seams.
Check platform adapters preserve authorized browser-context capture and discard third-party session material.
